scope:
Matched fully enabled native8/12 frontend fits: qualified serial vs factored.

Identical 50MHz registered shell, virtual IO budgets, device, fitter policy and
four operating conditions. No RAM-policy/clock/geometry change or deployment.

reference_manifest.scope:
Serial access to the selected native storage frontend's physical registers.

The host work continues during guest stalls. Only a final external hold stops
both domains; the caller must first drain accepted raw transactions and hold
all consumers. SDRAM refresh and global service barriers are outside this cell.
The guest advance must be the actual clock gate's pre-edge enable. This pins
the exact frozen native nondeferred source; changing that policy needs a new schema/gate.
reference_manifest.policy: Exact archived native nondeferred source, not the working-tree deferred-capable variant

candidate_manifest.scope:
Factor native frontend scan/normal D and clock-enable inference explicitly.

Preserves every physical register, initial value, update priority, scan bit and
interface equation. Only the existing clocked process is transposed into a
combinational enable/value process and enabled registers. No new sequential
state or storage policy. Area/timing benefit requires matched FPGA evidence.

candidate_manifest.limits: Component experiment only. No native integration, pause implementation, area/timing or speed claim.
